messages.subject: 5-a-side Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena — are you in for 5-a-side on Thursday after work? We're one short and Priya from corporate said she might come along. Pitch booked for 6.30 at the Finsbury leisure centre. Let me know and I'll confirm the booking.

Tom
